input.quote: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
input.rationale: Section 3(i) imposes a requirements-style exclusivity on us: we must source a credit report from TrueLink for every borrower underwritten through a System using the Interface, with no volume, term or performance-based exit. Although Section 2(a) preserves our general freedom to license or develop competing software and services, it does not cover credit reports, so the sourcing commitment stands as an open-ended sole-supplier obligation on the Client. Playbook preferred position is no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer, so we made the ordering right permissive and confirmed non-exclusivity; the fallback (credit reports only, 12 months, terminating on failure to meet the Section 3 performance standards) is offered in the comment. The non-exclusive licence in Section 2(a) and the non-exclusive Credit Data licence to TrueLink in Section 8(d) are not deviations.

ops.oldText: Subject to the foregoing, Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface.
ops.newText: Subject to the foregoing, Client may, but shall not be obligated to, order from TrueLink a credit report on any borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface, and nothing in this Agreement shall require Client to purchase credit reports or any other products or services exclusively from TrueLink.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the credit report sourcing commitment permissive, as our playbook does not accept exclusivity or requirements obligations on the Client. If TrueLink needs volume comfort, we can accept a commitment limited to credit reports for a 12-month term that ends automatically if TrueLink fails to meet the Section 3 performance standards.
proposal.summary: Remove requirements-style obligation for Client to order every credit report from TrueLink.
